task_metadata.research_topic: unconditional 3D structure generation across molecular and crystalline domains
task_metadata.research_question: Design a generative model for unconditional 3D structure generation that works across both molecular (QM9, GEOM-DRUG) and crystalline (MP-20) domains.
notes: Baselines and tests were linked to concrete citation records.
MP-20 is represented through crystal-generation benchmark papers because the task scaffold does not name a dedicated MP-20 source paper.

tests.label: MP-20
tests.notes: Crystal-generation benchmark lineage for periodic materials.

tests.label: GEOM-DRUG
tests.notes: GEOM dataset paper covering conformational ensembles for molecular generation.

baselines.name: edm
baselines.notes: Equivariant diffusion baseline for 3D molecule generation.

baselines.name: geoldm
baselines.notes: Geometric latent diffusion baseline for 3D molecule generation.
